title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 060
review_goal: Differentiate flask, folder locked, and fullscreen variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Round bottom flask with a narrow neck and one horizontal fill line
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a round bottom lab flask with a visible fill line inside the bowl.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the triangular flask or tall beaker when the lower body should stay circular.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot rounds the flask body into a bulb and adds one horizontal liquid line.

items.depicts_observation: Folder outline with a top tab and one keyhole in the middle
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a closed folder with a centered keyhole mark on the front.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the folder with separate padlock when the lock should hang at the lower right.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot puts a single keyhole symbol directly on the folder body.

items.depicts_observation: Open side folder outline with a small padlock hanging at lower right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a folder outline paired with a separate padlock icon at the corner.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the keyhole folder when the lock should be integrated into the folder face.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot places a small padlock outside the folder body at the lower right edge.

items.depicts_observation: Four corner crop marks forming an open square frame with centered space inside
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants fullscreen or crop corners shown as four separate corner marks.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the outward arrows icon when diagonal arrowheads should be visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows only four separate corner brackets with no arrows between them.

items.depicts_observation: Two diagonal arrow marks pointing outward toward upper right and lower left corners
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants outward expansion shown with two diagonal arrows rather than corner brackets.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the corner frame icon when the shape should stay bracket based with no arrowheads.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot replaces corner brackets with two diagonal arrows aimed toward opposite corners.
